values.note: 12 RV sites (1-12) with electric and water, 12 water-only tent sites (13-24), and 4 group/playground sites with no hookups (county campground map, 2026).

facilities.source: https://www.desotobocc.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/Brownville-Park-Boat-Ramp-1 ('A dump station is available for RV guests. The nearby restrooms include shower facilities for overnight camping guests'), read 2026-10-21

values.note: County's Firefly reservation portal. Check-in 1 pm, check-out 11 am; the park closes at sundown, so a late arrival must be arranged with the caretaker (863-491-5333). Cancelling costs one night plus the reservation fee; inside 48 hours, everything.

booking.source: https://www.desotobocc.com/Facilities/Facility/Details/Brownville-Park-Boat-Ramp-1 ('To Make Camping/RV Reservations click HERE' -> Firefly) + https://www.desotobocc.com/DocumentCenter/View/1794 (Check In 1:00PM, Check Out 11:00AM, 'The Park closes at sundown', refund/cancellation rules), read 2026-10-21

note: DeSoto County-managed 75-acre park on the Peace River ~5 mi N of Arcadia (RV Life mis-tagged commercial; county-operated). Campsites under old oaks; boat ramp, nature trails on the Great Florida Birding Trail, Peace River paddling and fossil hunting. --Claude
